description: drive.revisions.delete: DELETE files/{fileId}/revisions/{revisionId}. Permanently deletes a file version. You can only delete revisions for files with binary content in Google Drive, like images or videos. Revisions for other files, like Google Docs or Sheets, and the last remaining file version can't be deleted. For more information, see [Manage file revisions](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/guides/manage-revisions). Runs as a background job; completion preserves vendor response fields and names the selected account. Pass pageToken for the next page. Parameters use exact vendor names. See workspace_api_coverage.md for body schemas, scopes and lifecycle.
embedding_description: Use Drive Revisions Delete to permanently deletes a file version. Acts on the selected connected Google account and returns Google's complete response, including pagination tokens when available. Supply vendor field names for filters, request bodies and updates.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued; completion includes account, method and full vendor response or media blob.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show paging tokens so the caller can continue.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return one short message through the active IO plugin.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.unknown_account names connected accounts; gsuite.invalid_params names invalid arguments; gsuite.missing_scope requires reconnect; gsuite.auth_expired includes Testing-mode renewal guidance; gsuite.permission_denied includes tier or vendor denial; gsuite.not_found and gsuite.rate_limited preserve vendor messages.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Choose a connected account, correct vendor parameters, or reconnect with start_interface and connect_account to approve missing scopes. Retry rate limits later.
